known_limits: Cache write storage preflight uses Unix statvfs; other platforms refuse cache writes until an implementation is qualified.
Exclusive cache namespace locks serialize writers across lookup, execution and publication.
Crash locks and abandoned temporary data require explicit operator reconciliation; no automatic lock stealing or temporary cleanup.
Storage preflight is not a filesystem quota or sandbox against unrelated writers.
Inspection checks bounded metadata and inventory; full byte and acceptance verification occurs on lookup.
Proposed ADR-0009 is not an accepted architecture decision.
